dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Significant nonlinear narrowing from the wide mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical indentation visible on the left lateral margin posterior to the cranial region; right margin exhibits a more uniform convex curvature.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white to light-grey; high median pixel intensity consistent with adult pigmentation.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density dark-pixel clusters visible around the blowhole and along the posterior dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between shadowed areas and the primary white dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, vertical linear high-contrast mark extending longitudinally down the central dorsal plane; several small dark circular marks localized near the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A faint but discernible longitudinal linear mark (likely a healed scratch or rake) centered on the dorsal surface.
